introduction: Hi, I’m Neggy. I’ll show you the controls, then you can put them to work.
preparation: Read your role and points. Note your target, your limit and one reason for your opening offer.
negotiation: You’ll make the first offer. I’ll guide you through four quick moves. This round is practice, so its points stay out of your total.
ready: You’ve tried the controls. Keep practising, or head into your scored negotiations. Your next move is yours.

structured_offer.title: Send your first offer
structured_offer.instruction: Enter a fee in Make your offer, then press Send offer. Use my example if you’d like a starting point.
structured_offer.confirmation: Offer sent. Your price and points now appear together in chat.

conversation.title: Give them a reason
conversation.instruction: Explain what matters to you, or ask a question. You can talk without changing your offer.
conversation.confirmation: That’s a chat message. Reasons and questions can move the conversation without changing the terms.

chat_offer.title: Try an offer in chat
chat_offer.instruction: Type a clear price in the message box. You can send my example to try it.
chat_offer.confirmation: That counted as an offer. Clear terms in chat are scored just like the offer box.

helper.title: Ask me for a second view
helper.instruction: Ask me for a private suggestion. You choose whether to use it.
helper.confirmation: You’ve tried private advice. I help you think; the decision is yours.

complete.title: You know your way around
complete.instruction: Keep negotiating, or finish the tutorial. No pressure. This one is practice.

completion: You’ve finished the warm-up. Nicely done. Your next negotiations count toward your score, and you choose how I help.
